doc.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998

title: Prestige follow-up record and Nancy Wilson
summary: Rowe plays the follow-up to the hit; Jones recalls being on Prestige for quite a while.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Well you recorded on this particular record, this was the follow-up to one of your, I think when you had “Don’t Go To Strangers,” I think this was the record to follow it.
Does that have “Through a Long and Sleepless Night” on it?
In fact I was going to refresh your memory here.
I think Nancy Wilson listened to you.
I think so, when I hear that. It’s beautiful. You were on Prestige for quite a while.
Now when your recorded that, I’m always curious—
And thank you for what you said, you said beautiful.
